newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine inflation declines in most areas.
newsitem.headline: Philippine inflation declines in most areas.

text.p: The National Statistics Office said on Monday almost all commodity groups in April showed lower rates of increase compared with March figures.

The food, beverage and tobacco index, which make up the biggest portion of the consumer price index at 58.5 percent, slowed to a year-on-year inflation of 1.8 percent in April from 1.9 percent in March.
Inflation for food alone was 1.6 percent in April from 1.7 percent.

Housing and repairs slackened to a year-on-year 8.8 percent in April from 9.5 percent in March. Fuel, light and waterfell to to 9.4 percent from 10.5 percent and clothing to 3.5 percent from 3.8 percent.
Services were the only segment which was unchanged, at a year-on-year 11.5 percent in April.
However, on a month-on-month basis, the fuel, light and water component posted the only increase.
It rose to 0.8 percent in April from 0.6 percent in March largely due to the increase in distribution charge for electricity and higher water rates in Metro Manila, the agency said.
Fuel, light and water comprise 5.4 percent of the index.
